description_en: Obtain the service status metrics of skill groups. Support grouped queries by instance, time range, department, and skill group
description_zh: 获取技能组服务状态量。支持实例、时间区间、部门、技能组分组查询
kebab_example: aliyun aiccs get-skill-group-agent-status-details --instance-id ccc_xp_pre-cn-000 --start-date 1614824872 --end-date 1614824972 --page-size 10 --current-page 1 --dep-ids 111 --group-ids 123 --exist-department-grouping true --exist-skill-group-grouping true --api-version 2019-10-15 --region cn-hangzhou
name: GetSkillGroupAgentStatusDetails

parameters.help_en:
AICCS instance ID.  
You can obtain it from Instance Management in the left-side navigation pane of the Artificial Intelligence Cloud Call Service console (https://aiccs.console.aliyun.com/overview)
parameters.help_zh:
AICCS实例ID。
您可以在智能联络中心控制台 (https://aiccs.console.aliyun.com/overview)左侧导航栏的实例管理中获取
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en: The start date as a UNIX timestamp. Unit: milliseconds
parameters.help_zh: 开始日期时间戳。单位：毫秒
parameters.name: start_date

parameters.help_en: End Datetime Variable as a UNIX timestamp. Unit: milliseconds
parameters.help_zh: 结束日期时间戳。单位：毫秒
parameters.name: end_date

parameters.help_en: The page size. The value must be greater than 0. Default value: 20
parameters.help_zh: 每页大小。取值大于0，默认值：20
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: Current page number. The value must be greater than 0. Default value: 1
parameters.help_zh: 当前页。取值大于0，默认值：1
parameters.name: current_page

parameters.help_en: A list of skill group IDs
parameters.name: group_ids
